snippet.title: Trailer Vanova's Stories EN
snippet.description:
🎥 Vanova’s Stories: Official Demo Launching Mid-January! 🎉

🕵️‍♂️ Step into the shoes of a quirky detective and team up with your friends to solve captivating mysteries!

🔍 What Awaits You:

Unique and hilarious cases (murders, sabotage, disappearances)
A colorful and absurd universe that will keep you hooked 🎨
Cooperative gameplay for 2–4 players in real-time!
📺 Watch the teaser now and get ready to dive into a world where every clue counts!

💬 Let us know in the comments: Who are you bringing along to crack your first case? 👇
#VanovasStories #DetectiveGame #gamingcommunity 

Wishlist Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369640/Vanovas_Stories/

📌 Don’t forget to subscribe for more updates!
